title: House Bill Reshapes Marketplace Policies
description:
The "Online Sellers' Bill of Rights Act of 2026" would require marketplaces to explain account suspensions and give affected sellers opportunities to appeal.

title: Ecommerce Trends: How Lululemon is using AI
description:

title: How Spotify Uses AI to Personalize the Listener Experience
description: Spotify has been ambitious with its use of artificial intelligence to enhance its music platform. In the past couple of years, the company has gone from using AI behind the scenes to putting it front and center. This move has allowed it to transform how listeners discover music, interact with content, and even create their own music.

title: HubSpot AEO vs. Otterly: Platform or standalone tool?
description: Here’s the question most teams are actually trying to answer: do you need a standalone tool to monitor how your brand shows up in AI search, or do you need something that connects that monitoring to the content and CRM workflows that let you act on it?

description: avatarin uses OpenAI’s GPT-Realtime to give Yamada Denki shoppers 24/7 multilingual support. In two weeks, 30,000 people used the agent and 92% of survey responses were positive.

title: Time has started serving ads to AI agents
description: Time is selling ads targeting AI bots, betting that markdown pages will make its content (and advertisers) more visible in AI search.
